paper.title: Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks for Electrocardiogram Classification
paper.claim: The paper classifies arbitrary-length single-lead ECG recordings into four rhythm classes with a convolutional recurrent neural network.
paper.population: Serendipitous patient-initiated recordings from AliveCor devices in the 2017 PhysioNet/CinC Challenge; participant identities and a Brainstem validation population are not available.
paper.referenceStandard: Challenge-provided expert rhythm label for each 9-to-60-second, 300 Hz, single-lead ECG recording.
paper.relationEvidence: The arXiv record and repository identify the source as the paper implementation. The repository has no software license, no fitted model, and no participant identity with which to prove participant-separated evaluation.

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed expert-labelled short raw-ECG rhythm contract
requiredSignals: artifact-screened single-lead raw ECG sampled at the paper-compatible rate
expert rhythm labels and participant identity for separated validation
compatibility.window: Paper evaluation uses variable 9-to-60-second raw-ECG recordings, with a median around thirty seconds.
compatibility.preprocessing: Withheld until a licensed implementation and data freeze waveform calibration, filtering, resampling, augmentation, class mapping, participant split, fitted model, calibration, and uncertainty.
mismatches: The current Brainstem C2D contract does not export raw single-lead ECG morphology.
Brainstem records do not carry expert normal, AF, other-rhythm, and noise labels.
The source repository is unlicensed and cannot be copied or adapted.
No fitted model is published and the hidden challenge test set is unavailable.
The committed split stratifies recording IDs without participant identity.

cohort.output: Withheld; no licensed, participant-separated, Brainstem-compatible raw-ECG classifier has passed review.

personal.output: Withheld; no AF or rhythm label, probability, alert, chart, or free-text proxy may be returned from this candidate.
